science.title: Pumps, power, energy — covered
science.text: A real pre-workout hits every angle at once. Nitric Shock pairs dicreatine malate and L-arginine AKG for strength and skin-tightening pumps, beta-alanine to buffer fatigue and push endurance, and 175 mg of caffeine with a taurine-betaine-tyrosine matrix for clean, focused energy. Add a full B-vitamin complex and electrolytes, and you've got everything to attack your session.

items.q: What's in a pre-workout like this?
items.a: The classics at real doses: creatine and arginine for pumps and power, beta-alanine for endurance, caffeine and a taurine-tyrosine matrix for focus and energy, plus B-vitamins and electrolytes.

items.q: Why does it make me tingle?
items.a: That's the beta-alanine — a harmless, temporary skin-tingling (paraesthesia) that many people actually like. It's not an allergic reaction.

items.q: How much caffeine is in it?
items.a: 175 mg per scoop — a little less than two coffees. Start with half a scoop to gauge your tolerance, and don't stack it with other stimulants.
20–30 minutes before training. Avoid taking it within ~6 hours of bed so the caffeine doesn't affect your sleep.
Anyone sensitive to caffeine, pregnant or nursing, under 18, or with a medical condition or on medication should consult a physician before use.
